title: OPAG-70: strip CLAUDE.md's repository profile to contributor guidance
summary: OPAG-70 step 3. Replaces the four-heading fleet-profile structure (Role/Retirement machinery/What other repositories read from here/Constraints and couplings) with a short 'Contributing to this repository' section covering only what a contributor -- human or agent -- actually needs here: dev/main promotion model, the one required check, pointer to README for what ships and how to change it. The old section was entirely stale after OMARK-38/OMARK-39 anyway (described opum-workflow living here, session-hook fleet-scope enablement, fleet-internal task/decision ids like OMARK-29 and opum-agent OPAG-69, a reference to reading files inside opum-doc -- a private fleet repo a public contributor has no reason to know about) and the four-heading convention itself exists to let fleet orchestration scan every repo's profile in the same shape, which this repo no longer participates in.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No reference to opum-workflow, opum-agent, opum-doc, session hooks, or 'fleet-wide'/'orchestrator' framing remains anywhere in CLAUDE.md -- checked by grep, not by eye.
The operating-block import (OMARK-39) is untouched by this edit.
What remains is short and genuinely useful to someone opening a PR here: the promotion model, the one required check, and a pointer to README.md rather than duplicating its content.

finalSummary: Repository profile replaced with a short Contributing section. Grep-verified clean of all fleet-internal references.
